property: An equality filter term matches exactly when the entry's value set for the attribute holds the value.
statement:
theorem match_eq_spec (e : Entry) (a : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (v : PartialValue) :
    entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e (.Eq a v) = ok true ↔
      ∃ vs, ava e (nats a.val) = some vs ∧ ValueContains vs v := by
  sorry

ValueContains
spec.code:
/-- The value set holds the value (`ValueSetT::contains`). -/
def ValueContains : ValueSet → PartialValue → Prop
  | .Utf8 s, .Utf8 x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Iutf8 s, .Iutf8 x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Iname s, .Iname x => x ∈ s.val
  | .Uuid s, .Uuid u => u ∈ s.val
  | .Refer s, .Refer u => u ∈ s.val
  | .Uint32 s, .Uint32 n => n ∈ s.val
  | .OauthScopeMap s, .Refer u => u ∈ s.val
  | _, _ => False

lean.code:
/-- [kanidm_kernel::entry_impl::entry_match_no_index_inner]:
    Source: 'ports/kanidm/kernel/src/entry_impl.rs', lines 135:0-151:1
    Visibility: public -/
def entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner
  (e : Entry) (filter : FilterResolved) : Result Bool := do
  match filter with
  | FilterResolved.Eq attr value =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_equality e s value
  | FilterResolved.Cnt attr subvalue =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_substring e s subvalue
  | FilterResolved.Stw attr subvalue =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_startswith e s subvalue
  | FilterResolved.Enw attr subvalue =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_endswith e s subvalue
  | FilterResolved.Pres attr =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_pres e s
  | FilterResolved.LessThan attr subvalue =>
    let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref attr
    entry_impl.attribute_lessthan e s subvalue
  | FilterResolved.Or l => entry_impl.match_any e l 0#usize
  | FilterResolved.And l => entry_impl.match_all e l 0#usize
  | FilterResolved.Invalid _ => ok false
  | FilterResolved.Inclusion _ => ok false
  | FilterResolved.AndNot f =>
    let b ← entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e f
    ok (¬ b)
partial_fixpoint

def entry_impl.attribute_equality
  (e : Entry) (attr : Slice Std.U8) (value : PartialValue) : Result Bool := do
  let o ← entry_impl.get_ava_set e attr
  match o with
  | none => ok false
  | some v_list => valueset.vs_contains v_list value

/-- [kanidm_kernel::entry_impl::match_any]:
    Source: 'ports/kanidm/kernel/src/entry_impl.rs', lines 154:0-162:1
    Visibility: public -/
def entry_impl.match_any
  (e : Entry) (l : alloc.vec.Vec FilterResolved) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let i1 := alloc.vec.Vec.len l
  if i >= i1
  then ok false
  else
    let fr ←
      alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice
        FilterResolved) l i
    let b ← entry_impl.entry_match_no_index_inner e fr
    if b
    then ok true
    else let i2 ← i + 1#usize
         entry_impl.match_any e l i2
